# revoq

Open-source, file-backed, memory-mapped IPC stream for low-latency same-host
messaging and replay.

- README: https://github.com/revoracer/revoq/blob/main/README.md

## Integration notes

- Requires Linux for latency work, CMake 3.23 or newer, and a C++23 compiler.
- Initialize submodules before building.
- Link CMake target `revoq::revoq`.
- `revoq` API headers live under `include/revoq/`, but the build links
  compiled `revobase` support code.
- Core writer API: `Appender`.
- Core reader API: `MergingCursor`.
- Publication contract: write metadata and payload before release-storing frame
  `length`; readers acquire-load `length` before reading a frame.
- Portable benchmark runs are not publishable latency claims.
- Tuned latency claims require isolated-core host capture, the four-role
  topology described in the docs, and an SMT sibling map for the role CPUs.
- `revoq` is not a network transport, broker, database, or AI-agent framework.
